name: script_save
description: Save a named sequence of read-only or Browser Control tool calls. Scope session (default): for this conversation and its sub-agents, saved at once; the same name replaces it. Scope saved: propose a reusable script for later conversations with this agent; it is saved only after the user approves it on the Artifacts page. A step that would need approval is refused

description.description: One short sentence, about 150 characters: what the script does. Describe each param in its own description

params.description: Up to 10 distinct params usable as {{name}} in step argument strings

description.description: A few words: what text to pass

scope.description: session (default) for this work only; saved for a script worth reusing in other conversations

steps.description: 1 to the configured step limit (20 by default)

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, under 16 KiB as JSON; {{param}} inside a string is replaced at run time

tool.description: Tool name: a read-only tool, browser_read or browser_input
